_comment: Approved dependency/runtime version policy. Consumed by create, adopt, sync, and audit. Per-profile overrides may be added under 'profiles'.

frontend._comment: GOV.UK/MoJ frontend. Declare @ministryofjustice/frontend as the DIRECT dependency; it owns govuk-frontend as a managed transitive dep. Do NOT declare govuk-frontend directly, and do NOT reference node_modules/govuk-frontend/* by literal path (see design.md 'Frontend dependency direction'). Asset paths are resolved by @cica/nunjucks-govuk / express-baseline serveStaticAssets.
